original_title: Australia probes three near-misses in less than two weeks at Sydney airport

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: Three near-misses occurred at Sydney airport in less than two weeks, putting aircraft and flyers at risk due to potential air traffic control errors
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Investigations are likely to continue, and air traffic control procedures may be under scrutiny, potentially leading to increased safety measures
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: The incidents may lead to a review of air traffic control protocols and procedures, potentially resulting in improved safety standards at Sydney airport
ai_analysis.operational_impact: Potential disruptions to flight schedules and increased scrutiny of air traffic control operations may impact aviation logistics and passenger travel
